description: A documentary post-production supervisor must approve the final archival montage package and delivery plan for a festival premiere and its streaming release, including the selected footage, distribution scope, credits, and master specifications.

shared_context.S1: The documentary's archival montage is currently cut with the clip 'City at Dawn' as its second segment.
shared_context.S2: The current delivery draft specifies worldwide streaming, a 4K HDR master, a 5.1 mix, and an end-card credit reading 'Music by Mira Solano.'
shared_context.S3: Nora has authority to approve the final montage and delivery package before the festival master is sent to the distributor.
shared_context.S4: The production's standard finalization meeting includes a review by the archive, rights, and platform-delivery teams before Nora approves the package.

PF1.text: Malik confirmed with the footage rights holder yesterday that 'City at Dawn' is licensed only for theatrical exhibition in North America; the rights holder approved the replacement clip 'Harbor Lights' for worldwide streaming, but Malik has not entered that confirmation in the montage log.

PF2.text: Sofia's executed composer clearance requires the exact end-card wording 'Original music by Mira Solano' and requires the credit to remain in the final deliverable; she marked this in a legal redline that has not yet been circulated to post-production.

PF3.text: Evan's platform ingest test found that this distributor accepts the documentary only as 4K SDR with a stereo mix; the 4K HDR and 5.1 files in the current draft will be rejected, and Evan recorded the result in the platform test report after the draft was circulated.

acceptance_conditions: The second montage clip must be replaced with Harbor Lights.
The final package must retain worldwide streaming distribution.
The end-card credit must use the exact wording required by the composer clearance.
The master must be delivered as 4K SDR.
The audio must be delivered as a stereo mix.
A rights-record update for the replacement clip must be logged.
A platform-delivery update must be logged.

content_checks.C6: any('montage log' in c['detail'] or 'rights confirmation' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'delivery spec revision' or c['type'] == 'delivery_spec_update' or c['type'] == 'spec_update' or c['type'] == 'delivery_draft_revision' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The rights confirmation changes the second clip from City at Dawn to Harbor Lights, preserves worldwide streaming, and requires a rights-record update.
The executed clearance changes the credit from 'Music by Mira Solano' to the exact wording 'Original music by Mira Solano.'
The ingest test changes the deliverable from 4K HDR with 5.1 audio to 4K SDR with stereo audio and requires a platform-delivery update.
